Package uni.insubria.theknife.backend.entity

Class RestaurantEntity

java.lang.Object
uni.insubria.theknife.backend.entity.RestaurantEntity
@Entity public class RestaurantEntity extends Object
JPA entity mapped to the restaurants table. The owner is kept as a plain owner_username column (the FK is enforced at the DB level by Flyway), which keeps mapping trivial and avoids lazy-proxy concerns.
